feature: V3 first stage: local original-asset wildlife and regional particles
status: validated locally; opt-in defaults remain off; not published or installed

source_reference.adaptation: Reuses region, original terrain category, authored tree, daylight and visible-threat evidence. This bounded first stage is not the reference complete species catalogue or flock/perching/carrion simulation.

implementation.metadata_validation: docs/validation/waterfalls-2026-10-09.json contains the coordinated EN/RU/DE metadata and grouped-UI validation; new options are excluded from automatic low-tier presets.
implementation.actual_sources: Highest containing authored XY-jittered land triangle and its atlas terrain category; drawn non-wave liquid triangles including scripted owner offsets; actual visible scenery bounds and verified leafy model identities. Navigation water heights are never emission evidence. Base Gipat zone9 is Dead City; LiA Gipat2 zone9 remains outdoor.
implementation.visible_ground: Ground models match the current visible loose-ground vertex elevation, including installed dense footprint mesh subdivision, existing CPU track images and lifetime, actual material profiles, original jittered triangles and the shader water cutoff. Option changes re-seat held poses; live tracks are sampled during ordinary movement. No duplicate footprint field or navigation changes. The new query is checked against the actual packed B/A material profile for all ten census maps and a real snow footprint with rendered animal visibility.

base Gipat night fireflies over grass/swamp
implementation.clock_lifetime: Pausable node after visible-unit fog, existing terrain game clock only. Held time changes neither placement nor pose. Rewinds, gaps greater than 0.5 seconds and world replacement create fresh local populations without integrating stale flee trails. Options disable frees local nodes; loading/zone holds/movies/LMP travel stop updates.
implementation.avoidance: Only shown, living, unfogged, near-screen units contribute threats. Ground residents flee visible motion/combat; birds leave at night. Vertical floor separation avoids phantom threats and distant cave-rim animal admissions. Particle alpha suppresses overlap with visible units/combat.
implementation.simulation_boundary: No GameUnit registration, collision, save/network state, navigation mutation or gameplay RNG. Original shared EIFigure/EIAnim resources supply only local presentation nodes.

budgets.placement: 32 m stable hashed animal cells; 8 m particle cells with four deterministic roots per cell; fixed physical animal sizes, no camera-distance rescaling.
budgets.cost_limitations: Original full animated figures retain 24 rat/snowmouse parts, 26 spider parts, 19 frog parts or 3 bird parts. Shared figure/clip/material caches and the map-dependent authored scenery index add memory and admission costs. Bounds are implementation limits, not a performance result; no frame-time or long-route performance acceptance is claimed.

visual_review.method: Native full-map off / animals-only / particles-only / on / held / advanced controls at 1280x900. Requested leaf, ember and firefly cases disable wildlife and suppress other particle kinds; the frog case suppresses other animal models. The night case uses original authored midnight lighting. Held control requires zero changed channels using a two-level channel tolerance and also reports exact pixel equality. CPU poses and particle field records are checked for exact equality. Each independent visible layer and advancing game time must change pixels. Screenshots inspected at native size. Snow also compares actual footprint animal-off and animal-on controls.
visual_review.limitations: These are source-driven visibility probes, not composed gameplay beauty shots. Some authored map-edge/cave views expose existing cyan boundary fog and coarse original terrain; those surrounding render features were not retuned. Small physical-size animals remain deliberately subtle.

diagnostic_iterations.reason: The animal-only control found a real placement bug: the loose snow vertex layer rose above the original terrain triangle and buried the small model. Production now follows the exact visible loose-ground and live-track elevation. Build08 snow rendered78 and headless72 checks include option toggles, frozen poses, real footprint depression, restoration, unchanged navigation and independent visible animal controls.

Leaves independently rendered and held exactly, but the generic animal control failed because the tree-specific view had its birds 24 m off-camera. Requested particle-only cases now use the actual wildlife-off control; dedicated bird, cave, frog and snow cases retain animal visibility assertions.

Independent animal-only control revealed a fixture camera on the high outer cave rim. Fixture selector now uses actual MOB play-floor proximity; production admissions also reject a ground-height difference above 4 m. Not accepted as visual evidence.

32 m animal cell grid missed the small authored leafy tree footprint. Leaf visual selector now samples verified tree locations. The older5796 runtime hung after the failed fixture clean-exit trace and required terminating that exact isolated process; no native fix is attributed to this work. Final runs use the accepted090f runtime andd20a native.

remaining_scope: Reference larvae, bats, lizards, snakes, insects, crabs, ravens, vultures and snow-bird variants are not implemented in this first stage.
Perching, corpse/carrion attraction, group steering, region-specific bird silhouettes and species-specific flee destinations remain follow-up work.
Cave drips, mushroom-source spores, separate lava ash and broader regional particle taxonomy remain follow-up work. Waterfall particles are handled by the separate V4 helper.
Dense gameplay, long camera routes, mobile hardware, Android/Web exports and cross-feature integrated release acceptance remain outside these isolated checks.
Existing global fog, terrain materials, environment lighting and gameplay weather are not retuned by V3.
